controls.label: Shape model
controls.description: A prolate ellipsoid fitted to Voyager measurements and Hubble photometry. Its long axis is twice the short axis; the equal short axes are a source assumption. Gray grid marks unavailable registered surface imagery. Shared lighting reveals the approximate shape.
controls.title: Approximate shape model
controls.summary: Shape estimated from Voyager and Hubble observations. Two axes are assumed equal; gray grid: no imagery.
